description.value:
A dependency has become part of your daily routine, whatever substance it happens to be. You know the back-alley dealers, the going price, and how to spot the real thing from a cut batch, because you've had to find out the hard way more than once.

Whatever drove you to it — grief, boredom, or something you'd rather not talk about — you've learned to function around it, for better or worse, and the underworld's supply chains hold few secrets from you.

toolProficiencies: Your choice of any gaming set, brewer's kit, or spicer's kit
system.equipment: A chance cube set, a sabaac deck, two days of field rations, a set of common clothes, a bedroll, and a belt pouch containing 25 credits.
